name: IRONWALL LEAGUE: Full-Chrome Combat Football
description: Twelve-player teams of fully augmented athletes compete in a brutal hybrid of football and demolition derby across a 200-meter reinforced arena floor, with no limits on cyberware load-outs. Sponsored jointly by HelixCorp and Axiom Network, the League broadcasts to an estimated 40 million viewers per match, with live augment-specs displayed on-feed so fans can track each player's chrome configuration in real time. Hits routinely exceed 80g of force, and arena medics carry industrial cutting tools alongside trauma kits.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 feed technician discovers that a top-ranked IRONWALL player's augment specs are being secretly altered mid-season by a corponation exec to throw championship odds.
A retired IRONWALL athlete, stripped of her chrome after a contract dispute, surfaces on the Shelf running underground coaching clinics for kids with black-market augments.
An investigative journalist embedded with a bottom-tier franchise uncovers that several players were recruited directly from Shelf debt-labor pools with contracts they couldn't legally read.
